name: material
description: Natural, crafted, precious, and magical materials

entries.value: Iron — common strong metal used for tools, weapons, fittings, and armor.
Copper — workable reddish metal valued for vessels, wiring, coins, and alloys.
Oak — dense durable timber used in buildings, shields, barrels, and ships.
Limestone — pale workable stone common in walls, sculpture, mortar, and caves.
Bronze — corrosion-resistant copper alloy used for arms, bells, statues, and mechanisms.
Steel — refined iron alloy providing reliable strength and a durable cutting edge.
Silver — precious bright metal associated with currency, mirrors, ritual objects, and certain monsters.
Leather — flexible treated hide used for clothing, armor, containers, straps, and books.
Granite — extremely hard speckled stone suited to monuments, fortifications, and millstones.
Gold — soft precious metal prized for wealth, ornament, ritual purity, and magical conductance.
Marble — decorative stone used in wealthy architecture, sculpture, floors, and tombs.
Obsidian — volcanic glass capable of an exceptionally sharp but brittle edge.
Jade — tough ornamental stone associated with status, seals, medicine, and protective charms.
Quartz — abundant crystal used in lenses, timepieces, decoration, and basic magical focuses.
Amber — fossilized resin preserving insects, scents, static charge, and sometimes memories.
Pearl — organic gemstone valued in jewelry, diplomacy, water rites, and medicines.
Amethyst — purple quartz associated with clarity, sobriety, dreams, and spiritual protection.
Ruby — hard red gemstone associated with passion, blood, fire, and royal authority.
Sapphire — hard blue gemstone associated with truth, sky, water, and disciplined magic.
Emerald — green gemstone associated with growth, poison, prophecy, and enduring bonds.
Diamond — exceptionally hard clear crystal used for cutting, status, and durable enchantments.
Meteoric Iron — rare sky-fallen metal carrying unusual patterns and resistance to magic.
Dragonbone — light resilient bone retaining traces of the creature's elemental nature.
Spider Silk — extremely strong light fiber used in rope, clothing, sutures, and traps.
Mithral — rare silvery metal combining exceptional strength with very low weight.
Adamant — nearly unbreakable dark alloy requiring extraordinary heat and tools to shape.
Sunstone — warm translucent crystal that stores daylight and weakens creatures of darkness.
Voidglass — cold black glass that absorbs light, sound, and small amounts of magical energy.
Living Wood — harvested without killing its tree and capable of slowly repairing shaped objects.
Aether Crystal — unstable mineral that amplifies spells while accumulating dangerous resonance.
